description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailRecord class, which provides a structured way of accessing email details such as sender, recipient, subject, body content (plain or HTML), attachments, and metadata. It includes methods for parsing email headers and bodies from an IMAP server, handling MIME decoding, and encoding conversions.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailRecord
classes.description: Provides methods to parse and access email message details from an IMAP server, including headers, body content, attachments, and encoding utilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the email record by parsing headers and optionally the body from an IMAP message.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the email header details, including sender, recipients, date, and subject.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Returns the email body as plain text, with optional stripping of HTML tags.

methods.name: getBodyHTML
methods.description: Returns the email body formatted as HTML.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches and parses the email body content from the IMAP server if not already parsed.

methods.name: __getEmailIdList
methods.description: Helper method that extracts email addresses from header objects.

methods.name: __convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding to the specified target encoding.

methods.name: __mime_decode
methods.description: Decodes MIME-encoded words in email headers.

methods.name: __mime_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings into MIME format with specified encoding and charset.

methods.name: __parseHeader
methods.description: Parses email header information from an IMAP message fetch result.

methods.name: __parseBody
methods.description: Parses the email body, handling different MIME parts including plain text, HTML, and attachments.

methods.name: __getpart
methods.description: Recursively processes MIME parts of an email message to extract content and attachments.
